mathematical_scope: Validation orchestrator for four historical phase folders plus three phase15 scripts. It requests unittest discovery, records logs, counts tests and summarizes output JSON. It is not itself a mathematical proof or a historical execution record.
input_and_guard_coverage: Hard-coded paths, expected counts and date. subprocess timeouts are 120 seconds, but executable is the PATH-selected python rather than a pinned interpreter. PYTHONPATH is set to dot for discovery; process source identities and NumPy version are not pinned. Logs/results are overwritten at top level. Assertions are used as acceptance checks, so -O on the driver removes them.
cost_and_scaling: Runs suites sequentially and captures complete combined stdout/stderr in memory. Probe subprocesses also collect all output and parse every line as JSON. No aggregate wall-time/resource/size guard beyond per-subprocess timeout.
test_evidence: Expected suite counts are 10,15,12,8; a source count does not prove outcome. phase12 tests explicitly use skipTest when NumPy is unavailable. unittest returns code 0 and prints Ran N tests with skipped tests, so the suite acceptance parser can count skips as passed. If NumPy is absent throughout the same environment, the later mandatory unitarity_probe will fail, so that one condition alone does not produce a completed success report; the parser still does not distinguish skips or expected failures. Script probes require zero exit codes but do not verify expected row counts, parameter coverage, success flags, or output hash provenance.
dependency_identity: Assigned phase15 modules and local phase12/13 sources partly covered here; phase14 test suite/body outside assignment. All dependency versions and execution paths must be separately bound to source hashes. No subprocess launched in this review.

findings.finding: Exit code 0 plus the substring Ran N tests is insufficient to establish N passing tests: unittest skips and expected failures can satisfy it. The summary unconditionally sets passed=True and total_passed_tests to declared counts.

Successful script exit is not proof its assertions ran (PYTHONOPTIMIZE may disable them), and probe rows are counted without validating required parameter coverage or individual success conditions. all(...) on an empty FFT list would be true, although later max() presently prevents this specific fully empty case from producing a report.
Hard-coded paths/date and PATH-selected interpreter do not bind reported results to this exact archived source set.

acceptance_boundary: Accept as intended run workflow only. No claim of 45 tests passed or fresh result provenance follows from reading it, and its output schema overstates skipped-test acceptance.
